merits.name: Alley Cat
merits.summary: Navigating, hiding, evading or pursuing in your home city's streets: exceptional success on 4 successes (1 dot), 3 (2 dots), or any success (3 dots).

merits.name: Army of One

prerequisites.text: Carthian Status at least the Merit's rating

merits.summary: Once a story, call in Carthian backup: Presence + Politics + Carthian Status; one fighter per dot arrives in 10 minutes minus successes. Lose a dot for each one lost.

merits.name: Casual User

prerequisites.text: Not a member of the Carthian Movement

merits.summary: Not a Carthian but one of the crew: +1 Social with Carthians and counts as Status 1 for Carthian Law; once a story borrow a dot of Allies, Contacts, Safe Place or Herd; joining swaps it for Status 2.

merits.name: Court Jester
merits.summary: Can't be politically punished, short of death, for criticising the establishment; an authority who tries loses a dot of City Status and you gain a Beat.

merits.name: Devotion Experimenter
merits.summary: Devotions cost 1 Experience less (minimum 1) and get 9-again on activation; teaching one gives a Beat and passes on the discount.

merits.name: Fucking Thief
merits.summary: Buy one dot of another covenant's secret (a first Coil, a Theban or Crúac ritual, an Invictus Merit) at +1 Experience; any failure with it is dramatic. Once only.

merits.name: Jack-Booted Thug
merits.summary: Once a scene, a Willpower and Presence + Intimidation + City Status: those with City Status no higher than your successes must spend Willpower, at a penalty, to act against you or your Carthians.

merits.name: Mobilize Outrage

styleManeuvers.name: Strike to Preempt
styleManeuvers.summary: First turn only: Willpower adds your Willpower dots to an attack instead of +3, but you lose your next action and Defense.

styleManeuvers.name: Unbreakable
styleManeuvers.summary: In combat, Willpower adds your Willpower dots against Mental or Social coercion (or subtracts them from a resisted roll) instead of +3 or −2.

styleManeuvers.name: Dying on Your Feet
styleManeuvers.summary: In combat, no wound penalties and no torpor from lethal damage; only aggravated damage stops you, and you fall after the fight if still full.

merits.summary: The revolutionary's fighting style.

merits.name: Sell Out
merits.summary: A Carthian ruler counts as Status 1 in every covenant in the city, can lose Carthian Status instead of City Status, and keeps this even if drummed out.

merits.name: Smooth Criminal
merits.summary: Once a story, deflect an accusation against you or another Carthian: Manipulation + Subterfuge, contested by Wits + Subterfuge minus your Streetwise; success ends the scene's debate.

merits.name: Toss That Shit Right Back
merits.summary: Dodge a thrown weapon; if your successes beat the attacker's, catch it and throw the extra successes back at them, ignoring Defense.

merits.name: Breaking the Chains
merits.summary: Carthian Law: drink from Carthians with total Status at least (regnant's City Status + 1) × 3 to break a blood bond, becoming immune to that regnant. Can be taken more than once.

merits.name: Cease Fire
merits.summary: Carthian Law: with half the city's Carthians agreeing, Disciplines and Devotions fail without a Willpower and can burn their users, until you use one, leave or die.

merits.name: Coda Against Sorcery
merits.summary: Carthian Law: a chosen sorcery, tradition or ritual takes your dots as a penalty against you, and they add to Defense against weaponised sorcery.

merits.name: Empower Judiciary
merits.summary: Carthian Law: sacrifice a Willpower and Blood Potency dot to appoint a judge whose public rulings cost violators City Status, or burn them if they have none.

merits.name: Establish Precedent
merits.summary: Carthian Law: invest a Willpower dot to make a punishment precedent for a year and a day; knowing repeat offenders take 1 aggravated damage and a chosen Bane as a brand.

merits.name: Weaponize Dissent
merits.summary: Carthian Law: for a year and a day, in any scene you're present for, even as ashes, attacks on anyone add their City Status to the damage.

merits.name: Chorister

prerequisites.text: Not a member of the Circle of the Crone

merits.summary: Not in the Circle but welcome at its rites: +1 Social with Acolytes, can learn Crúac and Circle Merits with a teacher; once a story borrow a dot of Allies, Contacts, Mentor or Herd; joining swaps it for Status 2.

merits.name: Mandragora Garden

prerequisites.text: Safe Place at least the Merit's rating

merits.summary: Ghouled plants: work Crúac through them at a distance, add your dots to rituals among them, sustain scene-long rituals indefinitely; they need Vitae but yield animal blood.

merits.name: Temple Guardian

styleManeuvers.name: Athena's Armor
styleManeuvers.summary: On a turn you don't attack, ignore the first point of damage from each hit.

styleManeuvers.name: Enyo's Defense
styleManeuvers.summary: With Defense available, move up to your Speed to take an attack meant for someone else.

styleManeuvers.name: Eris's Glory
styleManeuvers.summary: When a hit deals you lethal or aggravated damage, an ally becomes Inspired; your wound penalties add to allies' Crúac rolls.

merits.summary: The Gorgons' style for defending the faithful.

merits.name: Viral Mythology
merits.summary: After revealing your divinity, Presence + Expression gives a witness the Seed of Her Divinity Condition; Allies and Herd dots come in pairs as your myth spreads.

merits.name: What You've Done for Her Lately
merits.summary: Once a story, in a scene where you succeeded at a Crúac ritual, add its level to your Circle Status for the scene.

merits.name: Crúac Style: Unbridled Chaos
merits.summary: Your rituals change nearby objects' Structure and Durability by their Magnitude (ritual level or Style dots, whichever is lower); a Willpower turns the weather. One Crúac Style only.

merits.name: Crúac Style: Primal Creation
merits.summary: Your rituals make nearby plants grow by their Magnitude in Size and creatures more fertile; a Willpower splits small living things in two. One Crúac Style only.

merits.name: Crúac Style: Opening the Void
merits.summary: Your rituals summon a strange familiar (a Retainer of the ritual's Magnitude); a Willpower opens the void to swallow a living victim. One Crúac Style only.

merits.name: Courtoisie

styleManeuvers.name: Establish the Duel
styleManeuvers.summary: Once your chosen opponent attacks you, others who close in take 1 lethal, and your Weaponry adds to Defense against them.

styleManeuvers.name: Value of the Spoken Word
styleManeuvers.summary: While taunting your opponent, use Expression, Intimidation, Socialize or Subterfuge for Athletics or Weaponry, Presence for Strength, Manipulation for Dexterity.

styleManeuvers.name: Demanding Attention
styleManeuvers.summary: A duellist who disengages takes lethal damage equal to your Socialize and is knocked down.

merits.summary: The polite duel, with hand-to-hand weapons.

merits.name: Crowdsourcing
merits.summary: An hour, a Willpower and Manipulation + Academics: each success moves a dot of Allies, Contacts, Haven, Herd, Resources or Retainer between Invictus for one action, even above 5.

merits.name: Information Network
merits.summary: Each Contact counts as a Specialty, used only with what that Contact tells you.

merits.name: Moderator
merits.summary: Moderates the First Estate's online network: once a story, use a dot as Allies, Contacts or Library, limited to what the internet can reach.

merits.name: One Foot in the Door

prerequisites.text: Not a member of the Invictus

merits.summary: Not Invictus but a supporter: +1 Social with Invictus; once a story borrow a dot of Allies, Contacts, Herd or Resources; joining swaps it for Status 2.

merits.name: Noblesse Oblige
merits.summary: Your official position replaces one of your Touchstones; losing the position is like losing a Touchstone.

merits.name: Prestigious Sire
merits.summary: On a fitting Social action, use your sire's City, Clan or Covenant Status instead of yours; fail and you lose the Merit.

merits.name: Social Engineering
merits.summary: An hour, a Willpower and Manipulation + Investigation: each success gives safe access, damning information, a Social edge or a weakness of the victim's. Once a story per victim.

merits.name: Tech-Savvy
merits.summary: With an hour, produce technology two Availability above your dots; split your dots among its bonus, Structure and Durability, with 9-again.

merits.name: Travel Agent
merits.summary: Can't be intercepted travelling between cities without beating your dots; bring a gift for a one-time Social bonus; once a story, half your dots count as Allies or Contacts in a new city.

merits.name: Oath of Abstinence
merits.summary: Oath: pay half your Vitae and a Willpower per Blood Potency to stop needing Vitae to wake; a single drink of Vitae ends it.

merits.name: Oath of the Handshake Deal
merits.summary: Oath: each side swears a service or prohibition and stakes a Social Merit, which passes to the other if broken. Can be taught outside the Invictus.

merits.name: Oath of the Hard Motherfucker
merits.summary: Oath: torpor or destroy a Carthian with Status to join an Invictus coterie: Invictus Status 1, a dot each of Allies, Contacts and Resources, and 9-again on two Skills.

merits.name: Oath of Matrimony
merits.summary: Oath: a union sharing Social Merits, Blood Potency and Disciplines, with family blood sympathy and a third-stage bond; the one who breaks it loses everything gained.

merits.name: Oath of the Model Prisoner
merits.summary: Oath: a prisoner can't escape or cause chaos without harm, and captors can't mistreat him without a City Status 5 sentence, or they and the ruler suffer.

merits.name: Oath of Office
merits.summary: Oath: your post becomes another Mask, and Willpower on its duties adds your Invictus or City Status instead of +3/−2; breaking it is detachment at Humanity 1.

merits.name: Oath of the Refugee
merits.summary: Oath: renounce your home domain; its citizens lose successes equal to your Invictus Status pursuing you; after a quiet month, trade it for City and Invictus Status 1.

merits.name: Oath of the Righteous Kill
merits.summary: Oath: take on another Invictus's detachment for a Masquerade killing, rolling it yourself with a bonus die.

merits.name: Oath of the Safe Word
merits.summary: Oath: two partners share a Social Merit and each other's Willpower; either can end it, paralysing the other.

merits.name: Oath of the True Knight
merits.summary: Oath: a neutral defender who can't drink Kindred Vitae; Dominate and Majesty on you suffer your Invictus Status, which is armour against Kindred and ghouls.

merits.name: Crusade

styleManeuvers.name: Shield Against Sorcery
styleManeuvers.summary: Armed and with Defense, magic aimed at you or anyone within your Willpower in yards suffers your dots as a penalty.

styleManeuvers.name: Silence
styleManeuvers.summary: Target the throat with no penalty; a hit can stop spells and some Disciplines until it heals.

styleManeuvers.name: A Hammer Against Witches
styleManeuvers.summary: A Willpower and an attack at −2 interrupts a spell or extended Discipline as a dramatic failure, adding its level to damage.

merits.summary: The crusaders' style against Kindred and sorcery, with hand-to-hand weapons.

merits.name: Flock

prerequisites.text: Herd at least the Merit's rating

merits.summary: Your Herd is a faithful flock: the dots add to Herd (above 5), they start scenes with Willpower, and feeding on them restores a Willpower.

merits.name: Laity

prerequisites.text: Not a member of the Lancea et Sanctum

merits.summary: Attends Mass without joining: +1 Social with the Sanctified; once a story borrow a dot of Allies, Contacts, Herd or Library; joining swaps it for Status 2.

merits.name: Sanctuary
merits.summary: Shelter a convicted criminal per dot as a 4-dot Retainer who can't safely leave your Safe Place; your dots penalise your feeding rolls.

merits.name: Sorcerous Eunuch
merits.summary: Magic against you loses dice equal to your Resolve, or successes if you spend Willpower; you can never learn blood sorcery.

merits.name: Stigmata

prerequisites.text: Humanity at least three above the Merit's rating, or mortal

merits.summary: You bleed holy wounds: lose a Vitae and take 1 lethal per dot weekly; drinkers become Raptured or Inspired, and your next Theban ritual that scene gets 8-again.

merits.name: Temple of Damnation

prerequisites.text: Safe Place at least the Merit's rating

merits.summary: A temple to your creed: actions supporting it gain your dots there, and those blessed in it can receive your Theban rituals from afar for a few nights.

merits.name: Independent Study

prerequisites.text: Not a member of the Ordo Dracul

merits.summary: Dabbles in the Order: +1 Social with Dragons; once a story borrow a dot of Allies, Contacts, Library or Mentor; joining swaps it for Status 2.

merits.name: Nest Guardian
merits.summary: Guards a Wyrm's Nest of its rating: no roll to use it, your dots to perception there, and they count as Ordo Dracul Status on its grounds. Allows Wyrm's Nest Merits.

merits.name: Rites of the Impaled

styleManeuvers.name: Beyond the Pale
styleManeuvers.summary: No torpor from lethal damage in your last Health box unless you also have aggravated damage equal to your Resolve.

styleManeuvers.name: Action and Reaction
styleManeuvers.summary: When hit and damaged, a Willpower lets you strike back with the attacker's successes, ignoring Defense.

merits.summary: The Impaled's style of pushing the body past its limits.

merits.name: Twilight Judge
merits.summary: Your rulings on Order disputes are final; defiance costs Ordo Dracul Status. You can't be refused tutelage in a Mystery, as a 5-dot Mentor for Order matters.

merits.name: Chapterhouse
merits.summary: Wyrm's Nest: everyone inside adds your dots to resist frenzy or stop violence, and Lash Out attempts lose them.

merits.name: Crucible
merits.summary: Wyrm's Nest: Coils learned there cost 2 Experiences (your Mystery) or 3 (others), and Scales 1.

merits.name: Feng Shui
merits.summary: Wyrm's Nest: choose a Skill; anyone using it in the Nest adds your dots.

merits.name: Perilous Nest
merits.summary: Wyrm's Nest: intruders meeting your criteria face twice your dots each turn in harassment, bashing damage or lost Willpower.

rituals.name: The Mantle of Amorous Fire
rituals.summary: Dance into a trance with Blush of Life, then a Willpower to rise: add Crúac to Presence for the night.

rituals.name: The Pool of Forbidden Truths
rituals.summary: Scry in a bowl of your blood: gain Primeval Truths, then Wits + Investigation + Crúac, asking one true question about the topic per success.

rituals.name: Mantle of the Beast's Breath
rituals.summary: Trance dance with Blush of Life: become Raptured with your Beast and add Crúac to riding the wave.

rituals.name: Shed the Virulent Bowels
rituals.summary: With a piece of a living victim, trigger it within a lunar month to burst their gut: Health fills with lethal damage, then 1 a turn.

rituals.name: Donning the Beast's Flesh
rituals.summary: Makes a garment from an animal's skin; any vampire wearing it can spend a Vitae to take a rough animal shape, keeping only Auspex.

rituals.name: Curse of Aphrodite's Favor
rituals.summary: A potion taken on three nights gives the drinker a full blood bond's obsession with a chosen subject (not the caster).

rituals.name: Curse of the Beloved Toy
rituals.summary: Kill a victim with Vitae invested; their ghost haunts a cherished possession, spending that Vitae to make its new owner's actions dramatic failures.

rituals.name: Mantle of the Glorious Dervish
rituals.summary: Trance dance with Blush of Life: for the night, 1 armour, +1 damage on hits, and you can't be ambushed.

rituals.name: Gorgon's Gaze
rituals.summary: Your eyes cloud until someone meets them; Presence + Occult + Crúac − their Stamina turns a limb to stone per success.

rituals.name: Bounty of the Storm
rituals.summary: Within a month, a storm strikes the victim among bystanders, killing a third of them and leaving the victim great wealth. Detachment at Humanity 2.

rituals.name: Mantle of the Predator Goddess
rituals.summary: Trance dance with Blush of Life: add Crúac to feeding and to Herd (above 5) for the night; those you feed on become Raptured.

rituals.name: Denying Hades
rituals.summary: Feed Vitae to a recent corpse to drag its spirit back; you suffer an unhealable aggravated wound while it walks.

rituals.name: Birthing the God
rituals.summary: A coven's Vitae and flesh birth a 'god' built from their offerings, which bursts out of the ritualist.

rituals.name: Mantle of the Crone
rituals.summary: Trance dance: for the night, witnesses gain Primeval Truths, your touch deals aggravated damage, and a Willpower briefly animates objects.

rituals.name: Apple of Eden
rituals.sacrament: An apple and a drop of Vitae
rituals.summary: A mortal who eats the apple gains Intelligence and Wits, sees the supernatural, and faces a breaking point; the Vitae in it can bond or create a ghoul.

rituals.name: Marian Apparition
rituals.sacrament: White cloth stained with a drop of menstrual blood
rituals.summary: Tear the cloth to summon a holy apparition; Kindred who lose the contest treat their Humanity as higher (by your Theban dots) for detachment.

rituals.name: Revelatory Shroud
rituals.summary: A shroud over an object or area shows the face of the last person to touch it or pass through.

rituals.name: Apparition of the Host
rituals.summary: Snap the switch within a month to loose avenging angels on a victim, who becomes Frightened; mortal onlookers are Spooked.

rituals.name: Bloody Icon
rituals.sacrament: Your own Humanity and a statue of a saint
rituals.summary: A saint's statue weeps Vitae equal to your successes, at the cost of a dot of your Humanity.

rituals.name: The Walls of Jericho
rituals.summary: Blow the horn within a week to strip a point of Structure per success from barriers protecting a low-Humanity vampire.

rituals.name: Aaron's Rod
rituals.summary: A Willpower turns the staff into a venomous serpent for a scene, obeying you or a command set when made.

rituals.name: Blessing the Legion
rituals.summary: Crusaders store Vitae in blessed armour, using it that night to heal beyond their usual limit.

rituals.name: Miracle of the Dead Sun
rituals.sacrament: A piece of pure silver jewellery
rituals.summary: Whoever speaks the phrase and gives up a dot of Humanity blots out the sun over the domain for a time.

rituals.name: Pledge to the Worthless One
rituals.sacrament: A person content with his life
rituals.summary: A heretical pact with Belial: double Vitae from sinners, constant frenzy's advantages, a demon familiar, but no Touchstones and a mark of damnation.

rituals.name: The Guiding Star
rituals.sacrament: A hand-made star chart and gold coins
rituals.summary: Enchanted coins point to a hidden sanctuary that serves as Safe Place, Haven and Feeding Grounds 5 for a night.

rituals.name: Great Prophecy
rituals.sacrament: A body part of a saint
rituals.summary: Write and read a sealed prophecy about a group; within a month it comes to pass, granting or destroying Merits.

rituals.name: Apocalypse
rituals.sacrament: A text at least three hundred years old
rituals.summary: Strips the Masquerade from vampires for half a mile (more with extra successes) for a week: they look like corpses and Obfuscate fails.

rituals.name: The Judgment Fast
rituals.summary: For a month, every Kindred in the domain vomits up any Vitae held above their Humanity.

mysteries.name: Coil of Zirnitra
mysteries.summary: A nearly extinct Coil that lets a Dragon keep or learn mortal psychic and magical gifts.

coil.name: Coil of Zirnitra
coil.summary: Lets a Dragon learn and use Supernatural Merits meant for mortals.

tiers.name: Opening the Third Eye
tiers.summary: Learn one mortal Supernatural Merit per dot; each use costs a Vitae, and failures are dramatic.

tiers.name: Unleash the Mind
tiers.summary: Spend Willpower to activate them and boost the roll in the same turn; drawbacks don't always apply.

tiers.name: Embolden Potential
tiers.summary: Vitae boosts their rolls like Physical Attributes; they cost 1 Experience less and no longer need Vitae.

tiers.name: The Dragon's Breath
tiers.summary: Willpower adds your Coil dots instead of +3, and failures are no longer dramatic.

tiers.name: Ascendancy
tiers.summary: Take an aggravated wound to make an activation rote; no limit on how many you can have.

mysteries.name: Coil of Ziva
mysteries.summary: A heretical Coil that clings to Humanity, rejecting what makes the Dragon a vampire.

coil.name: Coil of Ziva
coil.summary: Holds back the curse, at the risk of being branded apostate.

tiers.name: Denying the Bane
tiers.summary: Add your Coil dots to Humanity for your Banes' effects, clan bane included (not Ventrue's, fire or sunlight).

tiers.name: Buttress the Soul
tiers.summary: Spend Vitae, each adding a die to resist detachment.

tiers.name: Enliven the Anima
tiers.summary: A Willpower takes Raptured instead of a detachment Condition.

tiers.name: Embracing the Banes
tiers.summary: Sustain as many Banes as your Willpower dots, not three.

tiers.name: Shedding the Beast's Skin
tiers.summary: Three Willpower to become truly human for (11 − Blood Potency) hours, losing every vampiric power.

scales.name: Grafting Unholy Flesh
scales.summary: On a Wyrm's Nest, graft a supernatural being's body part onto yourself to use one of its abilities.

scales.name: Psychic Lobotomy
scales.summary: Surgery costs a subject a Mental or Social dot and their Supernatural Merits, but shields their mind.

scales.name: Bleed the Sin
scales.summary: Drain a subject of all blood for ten minutes; their next Humanity or Integrity costs less.

scales.name: Siphon the Soul
scales.summary: Drink past a Kindred's torpor to steal a dot of their Humanity, then face detachment and become Tainted.

conditions.name: Primeval Truths
conditions.summary: You've glimpsed truths beyond understanding and feel uncanny dread. You can't regain Willpower, and rising each night costs an extra Vitae.
conditions.resolution: Face the darkness: risk detachment or take another significant action that confronts the void.
conditions.possibleSources: The Pool of Forbidden Truths, the Mantle of the Crone

conditions.name: Oathbreaker
conditions.summary: You broke an Oath and the Invictus closes ranks against you. Two dots of Invictus Status and a dot each of Resources, Allies, Contacts, Herd and Mentor are off limits, and failures in Social actions among the Invictus are dramatic.
conditions.resolution: Risk Final Death for a member of the First Estate and have the sacrifice recognised.
conditions.beat: An Invictus punishes or pointedly snubs you.

conditions.name: Seed of Her Divinity
conditions.summary: You've been drawn into an Acolyte's personal myth: she gets exceptional successes on three successes on Social rolls against you.
conditions.resolution: Share and spread her myth (her Presence + Expression roll).
